problems.why: No finding says the 'בשקלים של העתיד' figures ignore inflation; finding 1 questions the 5% growth against the no-interest statement, which is a different complaint.
Finding 1 does criticise the figures, but it says the עו"ש money is shown growing at 5% when it earns no interest; no finding says the 'בשקלים של העתיד' view leaves out inflation.
